name: chip
title: Chip
description: A small pill that is a filter or a removable value.
use: A filter the reader turns on or off, as a label around a native checkbox or radio; or a value that can be removed, such as a recipient, a tag or an applied filter. A value may carry a picture, a category dot and a count; keep the remove button out of a filter chip, whose label is already the target.

instead.when: The pill only describes something and cannot be acted on
It is one value in a form that should read as one control
It is a yes or no submitted with a form

keyboard.action: Toggles the focused filter chip, as the native input does
Move the choice along radio chips that share a name

classes.name: chip
classes.description: The pill, 28px tall: a label around a chip-input, or a plain element that holds a value. On touch a filter's target and a remove button's reach 44px tall while the pill keeps its height

classes.name: chip-category
classes.description: A value takes the surface, text and line of the category set by a category-<name> class on it or around it; a filter keeps its face and shows the category in its chip-dot

classes.name: chip-input
classes.description: The checkbox or radio inside a filter chip; it covers the chip invisibly, so the label is the target and the input keeps the state

classes.name: chip-remove
classes.description: A round remove button at the end of a value; its accessible name includes the value

classes.name: chip-label
classes.description: The words: they shrink first and end in an ellipsis, so a picture, a count and the remove button keep their size

classes.name: chip-media
classes.description: A round picture at the start, the chip's height less two insets: holds an avatar or an icon, which it sizes

classes.name: chip-dot
classes.description: An 8px dot in the category's mark, or muted ink without one; decorative, so the label names the category

classes.name: chip-count
classes.description: Goes on a badge inside the chip: fits it to the chip as a concentric pill, and gives it a tone of the ink on a chosen filter

states.name: checked
states.description: The chip around the input fills with ink

states.name: disabled
states.description: The chip around the input drops to a flat well with disabled ink

properties.name: --chip-height
properties.description: Height; a field that holds values sets it for the chips in its well

properties.name: --chip-inset
properties.description: How far a chip-media or a chip-count stands in from the chip's end
